**Compensation:** Competitive hourly rate/salary commensurate with experience, plus product perks, mentorship, and growth incentives

**About ORGAID**

ORGAID is an organic skincare brand dedicated to developing clean, science-backed formulas using organic ingredients. We operate with a lean, entrepreneurial team where every member directly impacts our digital presence, brand story, and direct-to-consumer growth.

More than a specific checklist of past achievements, **we value attitude above all: passion, curiosity, high ownership, and a relentless drive to learn and grow.**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an ambitious, high-energy **Digital Marketing Associate** whose defining trait is an eagerness to learn modern e-commerce growth from the inside out.

If you are passionate about digital trends, self-motivated to master new tools, and excited to build real-world expertise across organic search, generative AI search, paid channels, and community storytelling, this role offers direct mentorship and hands-on ownership from day one.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. Email Marketing & Social Media Coordination**

* Plan, write, and schedule weekly email newsletters to subscribers (routine guides, ingredient highlights, seasonal promotions).
* Coordinate organic social media publishing, maintaining a consistent, high-standard schedule at least twice per week (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest).

**2. Amazon Marketplace & Paid Acquisition**

* Assist with Amazon catalog management, listing optimization, and product detail page maintenance.
* Monitor Amazon PPC campaigns, Meta Ads (Instagram/Facebook), and Google Ads, learning how to analyze ROAS, click-through rates, and conversion metrics.

**4. Blog Management & Content Strategy**

* Manage the ORGAID blog calendar from topic research through drafting, image selection, and formatting.
* Write informative, engaging articles explaining organic ingredients, formulation science, and skin wellness to capture search traffic and supply material for email and social channels.

**5. Online Community Management & Brand Engagement**

* Actively engage in relevant online forums and beauty communities (e.g., Reddit skincare boards, TikTok comment threads, lifestyle groups).
* Cultivate genuine customer conversations, respond promptly to inquiries and comments, and champion brand trust.

* **Passion & Curiosity:** You genuinely care about the work, stay curious about emerging digital trends, and take pride in seeing your efforts drive real results.

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Before You Apply...**
-----------------------

This is Kaizen's first dedicated events hire, and it's a build role. Our events have been run part time alongside other responsibilities. We have a conference presence, a set of shows we return to, and a handful of rooms that have worked well, but no owner and no playbook. You'll set the strategy, own the calendar and the budget, and be accountable for what the program produces.

The center of the role is the federal conference circuit: the Washington-area shows and agency-facing conferences where our federal buyers gather, the field motion that surrounds them, and the executive dinners and briefings we run alongside them. State and municipal events sit underneath the federal calendar rather than beside it.
